images.title: Five flags on a 2 km track
images.purpose: Show the 2 km cycle track with a flag after every 400 m: five flags at 400, 800, 1,200, 1,600 and 2,000 m, and the division 2,000 ÷ 400 = 5.
images.composition: A long track with a start mark, five flags at equal gaps and the position under each flag, and the division at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TRACK: one long flat rectangle, 1200 px wide and 40 px high (x 128 to 1328, y 400 to 440) filled grey #6B7280. START: a small green #009E73 square 30 by 30 px at x 128, y 340 with the label 0 under the track at y 470. FLAGS: exactly 5 flags standing on the track, each a thin dark pole 8 by 90 px with a flag triangle 60 by 40 px at its top, at x 368, 608, 848, 1088 and 1328 (poles from y 310 to y 400), the flags alternately teal #0072B2 and amber #E69F00 starting with teal. POSITIONS: under each flag at y 470 in 40 px bold, 400 m, 800 m, 1,200 m, 1,600 m and 2,000 m. PIECE: one reddish purple #CC79A7 bracket under the first piece from x 128 to x 368 at y 530 with short end strokes and the label one piece = 400 m under it in 40 px. Across the bottom centre, y 680, one line of bold text 2,000 ÷ 400 = 5 flags in 64 px. In all: 1 track, 5 flags, 1 start square, 1 bracket. All shapes are flat fills with thin dark #2B2B2B outlines (3 px), no shadows and no gradients; all text is dark #1F2937 sans-serif. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a flag at the start mark
images.takeaway: The number of equal pieces is the whole distance divided by the length of one piece.
images.description: A 2 km track with a flag after every 400 m, five flags with their positions, and 2,000 ÷ 400 = 5 flags.
images.context: Concept image for Equal Pieces Along a Distance. It follows the idea of the Kilometre Race in your maths book (stops after every equal interval along a track) and shows the concept's own example, a 2 km track with a flag after every 400 m (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Count the flags and the pieces together. The slip to watch: counting a flag at 0 or forgetting the flag at the end.
